reviewQuestions: Does Article 10 data governance coverage remain accurate?
Are bias, representativeness and provenance controls sufficient?
scope: data governance, provenance, representativeness and bias
risk management, logging, instructions, oversight, accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity

preReviewFindings.finding: The workspace must not imply that completion proves high-risk classification or legal conformity.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Approve classification boundary and all user-facing limitations.

preReviewFindings.finding: Dataset adequacy, representativeness and bias controls are context-dependent and cannot be proven by checklist completion.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Define minimum evidence and mandatory expert escalation.

preReviewFindings.finding: The amended high-risk timelines require exact article and system-category confirmation.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Confirm standalone and product-embedded dates and transition treatment.

acceptanceCriteria: Articles 9 to 15 controls are mapped without overstating sufficiency.
Data provenance, quality, bias and representativeness limitations are explicit.
High-risk timelines and role scope are correct.
Unresolved technical adequacy requires qualified specialist review.
limitations: Checklist completion does not establish dataset adequacy or system performance.
Classification depends on actual intended purpose and use context.
Technical specialist review may be required in addition to legal review.
